findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so no affinity-head derivative or extra model forward is available as evidence.

The learning window is the observed score-time support [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available for this study.

Continuous contrast features are reported only over the observed node support with extrapolation disallowed and observed-node linear interpolation; several landmark features show multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, so a constant rule is not supported and any time-conditioned rule must stay within the observed window.

hypotheses.falsifier: no sign change or rate reversal reproduced at observed nodes under validated interpolation
hypotheses.observable: landmark contrast features at observed score nodes
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule over the observed score window may better express the landmark contrast features than a constant rule, because the delivered continuous trends show sign changes and rate reversals within the observed support.

hypotheses.falsifier: joint diagnostics show no coupling beyond marginal features
hypotheses.observable: joint coordinate diagnostics versus marginal landmark features
hypotheses.statement: Isolated marginal landmark descriptors may be redundant relative to coherent joint coordinate patterns, so joint diagnostics should be consulted before treating any single landmark feature as an independent target.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst, so no causal selection effect or atom-velocity claim is supported.
Continuous contrast curves are not absolute reward targets and extrapolation beyond the observed window is not allowed.
Turnover, pair-kernel and moment diagnostics were not read in this turn and are not asserted here.
